CFML Language Reference: Functions

JavaCast

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Converts a CFML value so that it is passed to a Java method as a particular Java type. You need it when a Java class has several methods with the same name and the same number of arguments that differ only in their types.

Category

System functions

Syntax

JavaCast(type, variable)

Parameters

type
"bool" (or "boolean"), "int", "long", "float", "double" or "String". KoldFusion also accepts "null", which passes a Java null.
variable
The value to convert.

Returns

The value, converted and tagged with the Java type. Used anywhere else, it behaves like an ordinary CFML value: "int" and "long" truncate to whole numbers, "float" and "double" give a number, "bool" YES or NO, "String" a string.

Usage

CFML values have no fixed type, so the server cannot always guess whether 42 should be an int, a long, a double or a String:

<CFSET Emp.setJobGrade(JavaCast("int", 3))>      <!--- setJobGrade(int) --->
<CFSET Emp.setJobGrade(JavaCast("String", "C"))> <!--- setJobGrade(String) --->

Use JavaCast only for simple values passed to Java methods. The type sticks to the value when you store the result in a variable first (<CFSET Grade = JavaCast("int", 3)>) and pass the variable unchanged.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Call</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>JavaCast("int", 42.9)</TD><TD>#JavaCast("int", 42.9)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>JavaCast("double", "3.14")</TD><TD>#JavaCast("double", "3.14")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>JavaCast("String", 1999)</TD><TD>#JavaCast("String", 1999)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>JavaCast("bool", 1)</TD><TD>#JavaCast("bool", 1)#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
<CFTRY>
  <!--- String.valueOf has an int, a double, a boolean and an Object version --->
  <CFSET S = CreateObject("JAVA", "java.lang.String")>
  <CFOUTPUT>
  <P>valueOf(int 7) = #S.valueOf(JavaCast("int", 7))#<BR>
  valueOf(double 7) = #S.valueOf(JavaCast("double", 7))#<BR>
  valueOf(boolean) = #S.valueOf(JavaCast("bool", "yes"))#</P>
  </CFOUTPUT>
  <CFCATCH TYPE="Object">
    <CFOUTPUT><P>Calling Java: <I>#CFCATCH.Message#</I></P></CFOUTPUT>
  </CFCATCH>
</CFTRY>
